name: Banco del Bajío, S.A., Institución de Banca Múltiple
summary: Banco del Bajío, S.A., Institución de Banca Múltiple provides banking products and services in Mexico. The company offers deposit products such as immediate demand deposits, term deposits, and money market accounts, as well as certificates of deposit; commercial credits for business activities, financial entities, government entities, consumer credit, and housing loans. The company also provides financial factoring and leasing, securities trading, trust agreements, and intermediation services; derivative financial instruments, including forwards, swaps, and options, for trading and hedging purposes. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in León, Mexico.
